title: MAD I — Project
standfirst: A small end-to-end web application, submitted and defended, that puts the MAD I ideas into practice.
instructor: Prof. Nitin Chandrachoodan & Mr. Thejesh GN
syllabus_body_html:
This Project provides hands-on experience in building end-to-end web applications using technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Flask, APIs, and SQLite. It focuses on developing secure, efficient, and deployable applications while applying core web development concepts.

Co-requisite: BSCS2003: Modern Application Development I

Faculty:

  • Prof. Nitin Chandrachoodan, Department of Electrical Engineering, IIT Madras
  • Mr. Thejesh GN, Independent Technologist, Multiple Affiliations

How the project runs:

  • The objective of this project is to provide hands-on experience in developing a web application from scratch by integrating technologies covered in the course.
  • Students apply their knowledge to build a functional web application incorporating secure authentication, efficient data management, and API integration.
  • The project reinforces key concepts, enhances problem-solving skills, and improves proficiency in web application development.
  • The viva consists of two levels, with the final round conducted by industry experts and contributing significantly to the final grade.
